zoe_presales: CarterSec just asked for three tiny items for the SIG: single-sentence on custody, a one-line HSM non-export statement, and a 1-command POC. Can we get a minimal pack?
imelda_security: Single custody sentence: "By default Redwood manages CMKs; customers may supply BYOK stored in their cloud KMS or dedicated HSM, in which case the customer retains exclusive possession of key material."
imelda_security: HSM non-export line: "HSM-backed CMKs (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, approved on-prem HSMs) are non-exportable by design; attestation PDFs attached."
miguel_sre: One-line POC (AWS CLI) they can run live against their key or our demo alias/RedwoodPOC:
`aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/RedwoodPOC --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > ct.bin && aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > pt.bin`
harry_commercial: SOW note: "BYOK/import support available; on-prem HSM integrations may incur a one-time connector fee and optional support add-on. Exact pricing provided by commercial."
zoe_presales: Action: @imelda_security attach one-sentence custody + attestation; @miguel_sre attach the single-line CLI and minimal grant steps. Sending to Carter in 45 mins, ok?
carter_cust: Perfect, that should be enough for our vendor spreadsheet. Thanks!
